6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Pre-Drilled & Ready to Hang: Each wooden ornament features a pre-drilled top hole and includes natural jute twine/ribbons for easy hanging on Christmas trees, wreaths, and window hooks.
Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

Product Brief

 This cardinal bird crystal waterfall hanging light is a premium Christmas hanging decorative light powered by battery box. 
 It is topped with a vivid red cardinal bird ornament, matched with realistic artificial pine branches and plump red berry clusters. 
 Multiple layered hanging strands are decorated with snowflake‑shaped ornaments and faceted teardrop crystal pendants. 
 Warm‑white LED lights twinkle through clear crystal beads, creating brilliant light refraction. 

Product Specifications

 Product Name: Cardinal Bird Crystal Waterfall Hanging Light
 Overall Size: 25×25×55 cm (9.84×9.84×21.65 inch)
 Light Source: Warm‑white LED beads
 Power Supply: Battery box operated (batteries not included)
 Material: Resin cardinal bird, acrylic crystal & snowflake pendants, artificial pine leaves, red berries, metal hanging chain, plastic wire frame
 Package: 1 piece per set

Application Scenarios

 Covered outdoor: Porch eaves, front doorway, covered patio, gazebo, sheltered tree branches
 Indoor: Entryway, hallway, stairwell, living‑room ceiling, window display
 Commercial use: Shop window, café, restaurant, mall Christmas seasonal decoration
 Holiday occasion: Christmas party, winter‑themed event, festive holiday gift

Notes

 Powered by battery box, batteries are not included in package, please prepare batteries separately.
 Only suitable for covered‑outdoor use. Keep the battery box dry, avoid direct rain, snow and water splashing. Do not expose battery box to moist environment.
 Hang the item on stable load‑bearing hooks or brackets. Do not hang on fragile thin supports.
【CASCADING CHRISTMAS LIGHT DESIGN】Decorative holiday toppers combine with cascading LED strands, illuminated snowflake accents, and clear crystal-style drops to create a layered hanging display with strong festive visual impact.
【BRIGHT FESTIVE LED GLOW】LED lights illuminate the cascading strands and reflective crystal-style details, creating a warm, sparkling effect that becomes especially eye-catching in evening and nighttime Christmas displays.
【SNOWFLAKE & CRYSTAL DETAILS】Faceted clear drops, hanging bead-style strands, and glowing snowflake elements add depth, texture, and movement beneath the topper, giving the decoration a distinctive winter-inspired look.
【HANGING PORCH DECOR, NO FLOOR SPACE NEEDED】The vertical suspended design adds Christmas decoration without taking up lawn, table, or floor space. Suitable for covered porches, entryways, patios, windows, and indoor holiday display areas.
【6 FESTIVE STYLES TO CHOOSE FROM】Available in 6 Christmas-inspired designs for different seasonal decorating themes. Great for home decorating, holiday parties, family gatherings, entry displays, and Christmas photo settings.

 This Christmas projector light fills your room with classic festive patterns including snowmen, reindeer, snowflakes, candy canes, gift boxes and Santa sleigh.

 Compact spherical design with stable base, size: 8.3 × 8.3 × 8 cm.

Specifications

 Product Name: Christmas Projection Light
 Dimensions: 8.3 × 8.3 × 8 cm
 Power Supply: Type‑C USB (100cm cable included)
 Remote: Included (requires 2 × AAA batteries, batteries not supplied)
 Patterns: Snowman, reindeer, snowflake, candy cane, gift, Santa sleigh

 Package: 1 × Christmas projector lamp, 1 × remote control, 1 × Type‑C USB cable

Ideal for indoor Christmas decoration, bedroom, kids’ room, living room, Christmas party, holiday gathering, Xmas night ambiance. It is also a wonderful Christmas gift for family and children.

【Portable and festive】the compact projector is equipped with energy-efficient LEDs and an optimised energy management system. It consumes little power and provides a stable, flicker-free continuous projection - for a consistently festive atmosphere at Christmas parties or family gatherings.
【Versatile decoration for indoor use and ideal gift】This mood light is perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, studies and party areas. An ideal decoration for Christmas, New Year's Eve, holiday parties and family gatherings, as well as a thoughtful creative gift for relatives, friends and colleagues.

Christmas Garland
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Loop the ribbon tails around a rail or hook and knot at the back, then fan the loops out so the velvet sits flat. They suit parties, weddings, engagements, picnics and St Patrick's Day displays just as well.

5059442001194.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

5059442204694.baseName: Nordmann Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 5ft (150cm)
5059442204694.variantName: Nordmann Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 5ft (150cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 5ft
5059442204694.sourceDescription:
Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
